About.lead: RISE CREW is the official startup club of the SKKU ANCHOR Division. We grow founders who can execute through education, practice and global experience.

rise.title: Four promises in our name

supporter.title: SKKU ANCHOR Division
supporter.body: The ANCHOR Division supports RISE CREW. It is Sungkyunkwan University's division in the Seoul RISE (Regional Innovation System & Education) program, running from June 2025 to February 2030.
supporter.kpiFunding: KRW 2.4 billion in cumulative startup funding
